node_kinds.name: LLMHound_NetworkEndpoint
node_kinds.description: Fallback node for an observed IP or FQDN target that the asset mapping did not attach to an existing BloodHound node. The normalization program attributes it later.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_AIService
node_kinds.description: Umbrella label carried by every concrete service node (MCP server, A2A agent, AI service); does not own identity.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_MCPServer
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Model Context Protocol server endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_MCPTool
node_kinds.description: Tool advertised by an MCP server; enumerated, not executed.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_MCPResource
node_kinds.description: Resource advertised by an MCP server; enumerated, not necessarily read.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_MCPPrompt
node_kinds.description: Prompt template advertised by an MCP server.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_A2AAgent
node_kinds.description: Agent advertised by an A2A agent card.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_A2ASkill
node_kinds.description: Skill advertised by an A2A agent; advertised, not invoked.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_OllamaInstance
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Ollama service endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_VLLMInstance
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted vLLM service endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_LiteLLMGateway
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted LiteLLM proxy and gateway endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_QdrantInstance
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Qdrant vector database endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_MLflowServer
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted MLflow tracking and model registry server endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_JupyterServer
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Jupyter notebook server endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_OpenWebUIInstance
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Open WebUI frontend and service endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_LangServeApp

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_OpenAICompatibleEndpoint
node_kinds.description: Generic OpenAI-compatible API endpoint when no specific runtime product can be proven.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_RayDashboard
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Ray cluster dashboard endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_LangflowInstance
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Langflow visual AI framework endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_FlowiseInstance
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Flowise UI workflow endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_ChromaInstance
node_kinds.description: Fingerprinted Chroma vector store endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_AIModel
node_kinds.description: Model served or advertised by an AI runtime.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_VectorCollection
node_kinds.description: Collection within a vector database.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_WorkspaceFile
node_kinds.description: Notebook or file enumerated from a workspace or server.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_ModelArtifact
node_kinds.description: Registered model artifact or version in an ML registry.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_ArtifactStore
node_kinds.description: Storage root or bucket reported by an ML tracking server.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ObservedAt
relationship_kinds.description: Fingerprinted service was observed through this target: an existing BloodHound node named by the asset mapping, or a fallback NetworkEndpoint.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_RunsOn
relationship_kinds.description: Reserved for supported runtime placement; listening at an address alone is insufficient.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ProvidesTool
relationship_kinds.description: Tool enumerated from an MCP server; not executed.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ProvidesResource
relationship_kinds.description: Resource enumerated from an MCP server; not necessarily read.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ProvidesPrompt
relationship_kinds.description: Prompt template enumerated from an MCP server.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ProvidesModel
relationship_kinds.description: Model advertised by an AI runtime; inference not implied.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_AdvertisesSkill
relationship_kinds.description: Skill advertised by an A2A agent; not invoked.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_UsesBackend
relationship_kinds.description: Explicit backend dependency reported by the service; not proof of backend access.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_Contains
relationship_kinds.description: Collection, workspace file, model artifact, or reported artifact store association.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ExposesCredentialFor
relationship_kinds.description: Service content exposed structure-verified credentials associated with a native identity.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_AuthenticatesVia
relationship_kinds.description: Service delegates anonymous authentication or OAuth/OIDC sign-in to a native application.
